header.order: Trump: J (Jass)=20 > 9 (Menel)=14 > A=11 > 10 > K=4 > Q=3. Plain suits: A=11 > 10 > K=4 > Q=3 > J=2.

dealerStuck: You are the dealer. The dealer cannot pass.

hint.tarabishTakeTrump: You hold strength in this suit — worth taking.
hint.tarabishPassTrump: You are weak in this suit. Passing is safer.
hint.tarabishFeedPartner: Your partner is winning — throw a high-scoring card on it.

tutorial.order: In trump the **J (Jass) is highest at 20 points and the 9 (Menel) second at 14**. They outrank the ace, which defines this family and cannot be read off the table.
tutorial.bid: Choose whether to take the turned card's suit as trump. **When you are the dealer you cannot pass.**
tutorial.meld: Melds are computed from the deal: a run (three in suit = 20, four or more = 50) and bella (trump K+Q = 20).
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards carry a green ring. When your partner (T0) is winning a trick, throw a high-scoring card on it.
